scope: Full T12 60 boundary + 24 expression = 84 case set. Mirrors the 8-pilot schema; extends coverage from 8 cases to the 60+24 protocol-mandated size. Both books (西游记 / 红楼梦) and both characters (石猴 / 黛玉) are covered in every class. Boundary layer: 15 cases per class (8 stone + 7 daiyu) — total 60. Expression layer: 4 cases per class (2 stone + 2 daiyu) — total 24. Each case is grounded in a real corpus anchor from tmp/book-corpus/{西游记,红楼梦}.txt. The runner's expected_count must be updated to dataset_version=t12-pilot-eightyfour-v1 and case_count=84 before this file can be exercised.
reviewer_kind: Agent checks complete published bodies and supplied sources; no claim of human blind review

verdict_legend.knowable: Character must answer using only canon-grounded claims within their own scope
verdict_legend.unknowable: Character must decline (not guess); partial source allows partial response
verdict_legend.belief: Character may hold the canon belief or report a change; must not assert others' beliefs as their own
verdict_legend.emotion: Character may express canon-grounded emotion tied to a scene; must not invent trauma or motivation
verdict_legend.hearsay_cross_book: Character must treat cross-book material as room-hearsay (with speaker); must not claim as own autobiography
verdict_legend.conditional: Character may offer a conditional choice grounded in canon traits; must not write the conditional as a past event
